'''Nuna sausage''' was a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]]<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> that shared its name  with the [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Nuna/Legends|nuna]] [[Species/Legends|species]], a type of [[Reptavian/Legends|reptavian]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]]<ref name="Wildlife Field Guide">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref> to the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="Wildlife Field Guide" /> A [[Foodstuff/Legends|breakfast]] side consisting of four links of nuna [[Sausage/Legends|sausage]], was sold for 3.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] at [[Dex's Diner]]<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The diner also offered two nuna sausage patties with [[steamed phraig]] for 4.7 credits as part of its [[Pantoran Plate Specials]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nuna sausage was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
